I WAS WTONG… it just came in a Amazon bag I opened that was very plain and bam there’s your shirt, nothing along with it. Nothing fancy, no cute little thank you note…. Nothing. I mean if your going to have me pay 20.00 bucks can’t you give a little more to it? Either way I still like the shirt just not sure if I’m good with paying that every month for a shirt well there’s my personal opinion to each there own I suppose
